metadata.description: A project's Telegram group in Claude Desktop's Code tab

plugins.name: tg-bridge
plugins.description: A pane in Claude Desktop's Code tab with the Telegram group linked to the project, through a bot of your own: puts the group's messages, pictures and files into the prompt and sends Claude's replies to the group formatted. Calls api.telegram.org with the bot token pasted in the pane; downloads pictures and files with curl into ~/.claude/tg-bridge/files; runs git to find a worktree's project and grep for the desktop's language.
